title: CRM
for: pipeline, contacts, companies, deals, lifecycle stages

manual.export: Export the deals or contacts view as CSV from the CRM's list page (HubSpot: Contacts/Deals > Export; Salesforce: a report > Export) and drop the file into the snapshots folder.

vendors.name: HubSpot
caveats: OAuth is user-level: the server can do whatever the signed-in HubSpot user can, so deny the manage_* tools (mcp__hubspot__manage_*) in .claude/settings.json unless writes are wanted
The vendor page documents https://mcp.hubspot.com; Claude Code examples elsewhere use https://mcp.hubspot.com/anthropic; confirm which path your client needs on the day you wire it
Custom Sensitive Data properties are not exposed
Works on any HubSpot tier including Free; the Claude connector needs a paid Claude plan
The same server serves marketing-automation (marketing email, landing pages, blog, campaigns); one .mcp.json entry covers both categories
The local developer MCP (hs mcp setup) is for CMS and app development, not CRM data

auth.where: browser grant on first use; scopes follow the HubSpot user's permissions

cli.notes: developer tooling for CMS themes, projects and apps; it does not export CRM data, so scheduled pipeline snapshots need a script

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a private-app token (Settings > Integrations > Private apps) with read scopes calls the CRM v3 search API for a scheduled pipeline snapshot

vendors.name: Salesforce
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__salesforce`) until checked

Hosted MCP Servers are GA (Apr 2026) for Enterprise Edition and above plus Developer Edition; the hosted URL pattern comes from third-party write-ups because the vendor page returned 403; a person confirms it in Setup before wiring
Sandbox orgs use https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/sandbox/

The DX server (@salesforce/mcp) authenticates through the sf CLI's org login, so `sf org login web` must have run on the machine; its data toolset can run DML, so scope --toolsets to what the workflow needs
Field-level security and sharing rules apply to every call in both variants
Community alternative tsmztech/mcp-server-salesforce exists; judge it as a script, not a vendor tool

auth.where: browser grant as the Salesforce user; an admin enables Hosted MCP Servers in Setup first
reuses the sf CLI's stored org auth (sf org login web); nothing goes in .env

cli.notes: sf data query --query "SELECT ..." --result-format csv for scheduled exports and bulk work; sf data export bulk for large tables

script.notes: usually unnecessary: call the sf CLI from a workflow step and save its CSV as a snapshot

vendors.name: Pipedrive
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__pipedrive`) until checked
The endpoint URL is not printed on the feature page; it comes from a secondary listing. Confirm in Pipedrive's Marketplace or docs before wiring
Available on all plans; MCP usage counts against the plan's AI token limits

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the personal API token (Settings > Personal preferences > API) reads /v2/deals for a scheduled pipeline snapshot

vendors.name: Close
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__close`) until checked, or use the key variant with Close-Scope: mcp.read which exposes no write tools
Close-Scope takes mcp.read, mcp.write_safe or mcp.write_destructive; the key variant below pins mcp.read, change it on purpose in a proposal
Listed in the Claude connectors directory (claude.com/connectors/close)

auth.where: browser grant on first use (dynamic client registration)

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the same API key reads /api/v1/opportunity/ for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Attio
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__attio`) until checked
37 tools; write tools ask for confirmation in the session, which does not help a non-interactive run
OAuth only, so no headless path; a scheduled pull needs the REST API with an API key
Rate limits by tier: reads 100/s, writes 25/s, query-particle-sql 2/s (SQL on some tiers only)
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a workspace API key (Settings > Developers) queries /v2/objects/deals/records for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Zoho CRM
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__zohocrm`) until checked

Zoho ships four pre-built servers (Data Insights is read-only; Data Operations does CRUD; Modules; Workflow) but the endpoint URLs are not on the public page and the signup path is enterprise-only; no MCP entry until a person reads the URL from their Zoho admin console
Prefer the Data Insights server for questions; it exposes no writes

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a self-client OAuth app (api-console.zoho.com) with a refresh token reads /crm/v7/Deals for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__dynamics-dataverse`) until checked

Microsoft documents the servers for Copilot Studio and VS Code and says Claude Desktop is not supported at this time; the Entra ID grant may not complete from Claude Code, so treat the entry as a lead until a person tests it
A Power Platform admin must allow external MCP clients before any connection works
The URL embeds the org host (for example org12345.crm4.dynamics.com), taken from DYNAMICS_ORG_HOST in the environment
The Sales MCP server (agent365.svc.cloud.microsoft/mcp/environments/<EnvID>/servers/msdyn_SalesMCPServer) consumes Copilot Studio credits and needs an environment id; not wired here

auth.where: Entra ID browser sign-in; DYNAMICS_ORG_HOST is the org hostname from Power Platform admin center, not a secret

cli.notes: pac auth create, then pac env fetch --sql for scheduled table exports; the Dataverse Web API is the script fallback

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; an Entra app registration with client credentials reads /api/data/v9.2/opportunities for a scheduled snapshot
